exclusions.name: Bank supervisor Elena Cruz
exclusions.why_safe: She oversees receipts but does not control collection rate or shipping schedule, so her actions do not affect the number of units received.

exclusions.name: Other hospitals or blood centres
exclusions.why_safe: The question only concerns St. Vincent regional hospital's received units; other entities are irrelevant.

exclusions.name: Weekend collections or shipments
exclusions.why_safe: The drive is only open Monday to Friday, and shipments are only Tuesday and Thursday; weekend operations are not part of the schedule.

exclusions.name: Blood wastage or transfusions at the hospital
exclusions.why_safe: The question asks for units received, not units consumed; wastage or usage does not affect the count of received units.
